arguments.body:
### Triage Note

The app crashing on startup after an upgrade is classified as a regression. Please investigate the changes made in the latest version to identify the cause of the crash. This issue has been logged as a regression under the identifier `CANARY_d5a89a7d6c0e` for correlation. 

### Suggestions
- Review the changelog for recent updates.
- Check the error logs during startup for any exception messages.
- Revert to the previous version to confirm that this issue is indeed caused by the recent upgrade.
